district_name: Lamoille North Modified Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(E) inventory: Lamoille North Modified Unified Union School District, in the Lamoille North Supervisory Union (member towns: Belvidere, Eden, Hyde Park, Johnson, Waterville for all grades PreK-12; Cambridge for grades 7-12 only -- the district runs two budget entities, #058A PreK-6 and #058B 7-12).
Lamoille North Supervisory Union / district site (official).

board.org_name: Lamoille North Modified Unified Union School Board

sources.note: LNMUUSD 2026 Annual Report (official): "Board of Directors & Terms" table -- 19 seats apportioned Belvidere 1, Cambridge 6, Eden 2, Hyde Park 4, Johnson 5, Waterville 1, with a term-end year for each member (pre-election). The FY27 warning (same district) warns no director seats -- directors are elected on the member towns' own ballots; its budget ballots are commingled district-wide, yet the March 9, 2026 minutes speak of "three open Johnson board seats," proving the seats are town seats on town ballots (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern). The Articles of Agreement were not located.

LNMUUSD board minutes, March 9, 2026 reorganization (official): members present by town, and the appointment of Liz Kauffman to one of the three open Johnson seats (motion passed unanimously). The April 13, 2026 minutes list Elizabeth Aloisio and Scott Meyer as Johnson members (appointments between March 9 and April 13; the appointment minutes were not posted). The December 8, 2025 minutes record Tiffany Cochran appointed to the open Eden seat of the late David Whitcomb.

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern -- town-only electorates). Cambridge members sit only for the grades 7-12 (District B) side of the district; Cambridge also elects its own town district board (modeled separately).

directors.name: David Whitcomb

directors.name: Liz Kauffman
directors.note: Appointed March 9, 2026 to one of the three Johnson seats left open by the March 3, 2026 ballot (minutes verbatim). No term stated in the minutes; none asserted.

directors.name: Elizabeth Aloisio

directors.name: Scott Meyer
